description: Parses a raw lead email, form submission, or webhook payload into a structured contact record, enriches it, and logs it to your CRM. Returns name, email, company, phone, and ICP score.

crm_push.description: Push enriched lead to CRM after intake. Defaults to true.

raw_content.description: Raw email body, form submission JSON, or webhook payload to parse.

source.description: Where the lead came from: 'email', 'form', 'webhook', or 'manual'.

name: yax_enrich_lead_data

crm_synced.description: True if lead was pushed to CRM.

lead.description: Structured lead record: name, email, company, phone, source, enrichment, ICP score.
